svg.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: BenchBook action buttons and icon map reference
svg.title: BenchBook action buttons and icon map reference
svg.text: Every action button has a lucide-react icon on the left of its label. Same action = same icon and same words everywhere.
One primary per screen. Destructive actions are red and always ask first.
Max 2 visible + More. Rest go in the menu.
Sticky bottom bar on detail and form pages.
PCR Unit 01 · Today 13:00–15:00. A reason is required.
Teal tile = normal · gradient tile = usually the page's primary · red tile = destructive (confirm first)
Icon left of the label, 16 px (18 px on 46 px buttons), aria-hidden.
Labels: sentence case verb + noun ("Cancel booking", not "Cancel Reservation").
Icon-only buttons need aria-label and a tooltip. Never for destructive actions.
Destructive = red style + ConfirmAction dialog that repeats the icon and the label.
Busy state: spinner replaces the icon, label stays, button disabled.
Disabled actions explain why in a tooltip or helper text (e.g. Book on retired items).
Touch targets at least 44 px on phones; row actions become full-width buttons.
